exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.description: A bodyweight exercise that works the chest, shoulders and triceps. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels and lower your chest toward the floor.

exercises.name: Squat
exercises.description: A lower-body exercise that works the quads, glutes and hamstrings. Keep your chest up and push your hips back as you bend your knees.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: A core exercise that builds stability through the abs, back and shoulders. Rest on your forearms and toes and hold your body in a straight line without letting your hips sag.
exercises.safety: Keep your hips level and your neck in line with your spine. If your lower back starts to ache, drop to your knees or rest.

pathways.name: Beginner Strength
pathways.description: A two-week introduction to bodyweight strength training, alternating upper- and lower-body days with rest in between.
